title: Moscow, November 5 - Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council made remarks in an interview.
text:
Moscow, November 5 - Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council made remarks in an interview."

"———-"

"SOT1, Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:31): “I was the messenger of the Supreme Leader of Iran for Mr. Putin. Of course, this trip was supposed to take place about a month ago, but it was delayed due to special circumstances, as discussions regarding the military situation in the region were being raised every day. The Supreme Leader wished for me to present his message to His Excellency Mr. Putin, the honorable President of the Russian Federation, as soon as possible.”"

"SOT2, Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council (Farsi) (00:32 - 01:06): “We consulted with him [ Mr. Putin] regarding important issues we have in the region. Currently, important discussions are being raised regarding the post-war period, especially concerning regional security arrangements. I submitted a report on the four-country meeting in Tehran, and he welcomed it. He stated that, like our Chinese friends, we believe there should be regional arrangements in place and that foreign countries should not interfere in the security of the region.”"

""
"SOT3, Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council (Farsi) (01:07 - 01:48): “The issue of the Rasht-Astara corridor was discussed, which fortunately the Supreme National Security Council approved, and our Minister of Roads will soon implement this contract following the signing. Discussions regarding the construction of gas pipelines from Russia to Iran, which would both address Iran’s own gas shortages and allow us to sell Russian gas to the countries surrounding Iran, were very important discussions regarding our future relations with Mr. Vladimir Putin.”"

"SOT4, Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council (Farsi) (01:49 - 02:46): “Regarding military matters, he strongly and firmly condemned the military attacks by the United States and Israel against Iran. He condemned the bombing of Iran’s nuclear sites and believed that this was an unjust war that must end as quickly as possible. He stated that we are ready to provide any assistance possible to help end the war. However, we informed them that regarding the diplomacy, we have declared seven conditions to the Americans, and until the Americans fulfill our seven conditions, neither the Strait of Hormuz will be opened nor will there be any negotiations. The diplomacy currently taking place is solely to ensure that the Americans pay our rights.”
